arabic: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ، فَلْيُبَرِّكْ عَلَيْهِ، فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ.
translation: If any of you sees something from his brother, or from himself, or from his wealth which impresses him, let him invoke blessings for it (saying May Allah bless it), for the evil eye is a reality.
reference: Ahmad 4/447, Ibn Majah, Malik. Authenticated by Al-Albani
